After she stood firm, she realized that the car was not parked in the parking lot she was familiar with. Where is this? Xia Wan'an looked at Special Assistant Zhang in confusion. Before she could speak, just receiving her gaze, Special Assistant Zhang had already given the answer: "Madam, this is the Four Seasons Hotel." Four Seasons Hotel? What are you doing at the hotel? Xia Wan'an was even more puzzled. "Here tomorrow, the company has a banquet, and a client has just checked into the hotel. I have something to discuss with Mr. Han. Because I am running out of time, I came here temporarily..." No wonder she didn't see him when she woke up. He must have gone upstairs to work, right? Xia Wan'an thought for a moment and said wisely: "Then I'll call a car and go home, so I won't disturb you." "Madam, it's not impossible for you to go home if you want, but Mr. Han didn't tell you to go alone. Also, if Madam, you should tell Mr. Han..." When Mr. Han got out of the car, he didn't mention Madam. He didn't know what Mr. Han meant. What if Mr. Han blamed him if he let Madam go? After thinking about it, Special Assistant Zhang spoke again: "Madam, how about this? I'll take you to rest upstairs first. It's getting late now. Mr. Han's work should be finished soon. If you want to go back then, tell him yourself..." Xia Wan'an was not a cold-hearted person. Seeing Assistant Zhang's embarrassed face, he could only say with unbearable reluctance: "Okay." Assistant Zhang took Xia Wan'an directly to the suite on the top floor of the hotel. "Madam, this is Mr. Han's room. You sit here and rest for a while. I'll go check on Mr. Han's situation." Assistant Zhang opened the door for Xia Wan'an and stood at the door. Xia Wan'an nodded slightly and said "thank you", then stepped into the suite. After the door closed, she walked inside. The desk was covered with a thick stack of documents, there were several coats and pairs of shoes hanging in the cabinet at the entrance, and there were even a few neatly stacked shirts on the sofa... Judging from this scene, Xia Wan'an thought that the time he stayed in the hotel might be... They came home much more often than he did... Although Xia Wan'an carefully observed Han Jingnian's things, she did not dare to touch anything that belonged to him in the house. Even when she sat down, she found an empty sofa in front of the floor-to-ceiling window. She waited for a long time, but instead of waiting for Han Jingnian to come back, she fell asleep waiting for her. When she woke up again, it was bright outside the window, and she was lying on the bed without knowing when she was originally nestled on the sofa. Xia Wan'an looked around the bedroom, but didn't see Han Jingnian. She went to the bathroom to wash up briefly, then opened the door and walked out. She saw Han Jingnian and Special Assistant Zhang in front of the desk in the living room of the suite. "Morning, madam." Xia Wan'an responded "Morning" to Special Assistant Zhang's greeting with a smile, then glanced at Han Jingnian quickly, and whispered: "Morning." Han Jingnian was as indifferent to her words as he was in the car last night. They seemed to have something important to talk about. After saying hello, Special Assistant Zhang started talking about business: "Secretary Sun is in an emergency and has been admitted to the hospital, so Mr. Han, who do you want to be your female companion for the banquet tonight?"...
